title: Ends of infinite clusters in the nonuniqueness phase
exact_target: In the nonunique phase on a quasi-transitive graph, must every infinite cluster have continuum many ends?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000085 (AMR-099-0085). CC BY 4.0.

Itai Benjamini and Oded Schramm, \emph{Percolation beyond $\mathbb Z^d$, many questions and a few answers}, Electronic Communications in Probability 1 (1996), 71--82, Section 2, conventions, p. 72; Section 4, Conjecture 5, p. 76.
